judgeDesc: Commands that fall <hl>within the intercept scope</hl> and <hl>match no intercept rule</hl> are judged semantically by the model (allow / ask a human / deny)
tokenDesc: Cumulative usage of model fallback approval, metered separately (worker=judge), not mixed with the per-profile stats
sparkTitle: Daily usage over the last 30 days (input + output)
promptDesc: The model uses this to decide ALLOW / ASK / DENY. You can edit it directly.
promptPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the built-in template
onModelFail: When the model fails (error / timeout / unparseable)
humanTitle: Human approval (when the model says "ask a human")
loadJudgeFailed: Failed to load model fallback settings: {message}
pageDesc: Before a tool runs, its command is matched against the intercept rules; commands that match nothing can be passed to the model for fallback judgement
scopeEmpty: No tools enabled: intercept rules and model fallback both have no effect
rulesDesc: Rules are matched one by one in priority order (higher number first); the first matching rule applies
formDesc: Higher priority is matched first; the first matching rule applies and the rest are skipped
re2Hint: Uses Go RE2 extended syntax (e.g. (?i)). The browser can't preview it; the server validates it on submit.
actionAllowDesc: Allow — let it through directly and skip the remaining rules
actionDenyDesc: Deny — block it and return a refusal message to the model
askTimeoutDesc: Dispose automatically after the timeout instead of waiting
scopeSheetDesc: Only tools with intercept enabled go through rule matching; other tools are allowed directly
toolShellOpen: Open a persistent interactive PTY session
toolShellSend: Send input to an interactive session
toolShellRead: Read output from an interactive session
